options.name: Crimson
options.why: the first candidate, kept for comparison: near the case's complement at full chroma

options.name: Porcelain
options.why: a light neutral: Porcelain, a cool near-white that reads as brushed aluminium; the most contrast in value and none in hue, its faint green cast the case's own

options.name: Dijon
options.why: a warm metal: Dijon, a muted gold about a third of the wheel from the case (a triad, not a complement), the racing green and gold of the classic pairing

options.name: Sage
options.why: a lighter green: Sage, from the case's own family, greyed and far lighter: an analogous, tone-on-tone pairing (and the AirPods case's shade in land 4)

options.name: Graphite
options.why: a dark neutral: Graphite, gunmetal; a green darker than the case would vanish on it, so the dark option is a neutral, the quietest of the four
